zh.title: 認識 AI Tools：用魔法打敗魔法！
zh.description: 在 AI 浪潮席捲而來的今天，懂得善用工具比會寫程式更重要！本課程將帶領學員從零認識各種實用 AI 工具，學會撰寫有效的 Prompt，並透過趣味互動挑戰「擊敗 AI」的任務 —— 試著在最少提示次數內釣出隱藏的 Secret！從基礎觀念到實際操作，透過一場遊戲化的課程體驗，學員將學會如何與 AI 協作、優化思維，發揮創意解題。最後還有分享與交流時間，一起討論你的破解策略！

en.title: Discover AI Tools: Beat magic with magic!
en.description: In today's AI-driven world, knowing how to effectively use tools is more important than being a programmer! This course will guide participants from scratch to understanding various practical AI tools, learning how to write effective prompts, and engaging in a fun, interactive challenge to "defeat AI"—trying to fish out a hidden secret with the fewest hints possible! From basic concepts to practical operations, through a gamified learning experience, participants will learn how to collaborate with AI, optimize their thinking, and unleash their creativity in problem-solving. Finally, there will be a sharing and discussion session to discuss your solutions!

zh.title: 廣度課程 - 生成式 AI
zh.description: 生成式 AI 在近年大放異彩，在生活中的應用也越發常見。不過亮眼應用背後的原理並非黑魔法，而是一套嚴謹且有趣的科學。本堂廣度課程會帶領大家簡單認識文字與圖像背後的模型究竟怎麼運作，有什麼理論基礎，以及學界正在往什麼方向前進。期待能解密生成式 AI 背後的有趣原理！

en.title: Breadth-based curriculum - Generative AI
en.description: Generative AI has shone brightly in recent years, and its applications in daily life are becoming increasingly common. However, the principles behind these impressive applications are not black magic, but a rigorous and fascinating science. This in-depth course will guide you through a simple understanding of how the models behind text and images actually work, their theoretical foundations, and the direction the academic community is heading. We look forward to unlocking the fascinating principles behind generative AI!

zh.title: 闖關活動
zh.description:
『學程式到底要拿來做什麼？』這可能是很多人都有的疑問。沒錯，不會程式還是可以去麥當勞點餐，可以用電腦玩遊戲，可以在 IG 發限動。但是，不會程式的話，絕對沒有辦法完成這項考驗。

不管你是屬於用心觀察環境，仔細思考線索的頭腦派；抑或是想法源源不絕，追求程式效能的實力派，融合學習至今的程式、邏輯、解謎和團隊合作的能力，在解決一道道謎題的過程中，感受到其中的韻味，以及找尋『學習程式』的意義吧！

en.title: Challenge Activity
en.description:
"What exactly is the purpose of learning programming?" This is a question many people have. Yes, you can still order food at McDonald's, play games on a computer, and post on Instagram stories even without programming skills. However, without programming, you absolutely cannot complete this challenge.

Whether you're the type who carefully observes your environment and meticulously considers clues, or the type who has a constant stream of ideas and pursues program efficiency, combine your programming, logic, puzzle-solving, and teamwork skills learned so far to experience the charm of solving each puzzle and discover the meaning of "learning programming"!

zh.title: Python 基礎語法：寫程式就從這裡開始！
zh.description: 想學 Python 卻不知道從何開始？這堂課將帶你用最平易近人的方式，從環境安裝、基礎語法到實作練習，一步步踏入 Python 的世界。我們將介紹變數、運算子、字串處理、判斷式與迴圈等核心觀念，讓你不只會看、也能寫出自己的程式。過程中搭配 VSCode 的操作教學與實作題目，幫助你在動手中加深理解。無論你是第一次寫程式，還是想打好基礎重新出發，都能在這堂課找到你的節奏。從 0 到 1，讓 Python 成為你邁向資訊世界的第一步！

en.title: Python Basic Syntax: Get Started with Programming!
en.description: Want to learn Python but don't know where to start? This course will guide you step-by-step into the world of Python in the most approachable way, from environment setup and basic syntax to practical exercises. We'll introduce core concepts such as variables, operators, string manipulation, conditional statements, and loops, so you can not only read but also write your own programs. The course includes VSCode tutorials and practical exercises to help you deepen your understanding through hands-on practice. Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to build a solid foundation, you'll find your rhythm in this course. From zero to one, let Python be your first step into the world of information technology!

zh.title: Python 資料結構：讓資料井然有序！
zh.description: 資料太多不知道怎麼存？這堂課將帶你認識 Python 中最常用的四種資料結構：list、tuple、set、dict，教你如何用正確的方式整理與操作資訊。從「怎麼存」到「怎麼找」、「什麼時候該用哪一種」，搭配實作練習幫你快速上手。除此之外，我們還會介紹如何將 dict 轉換成 JSON 格式，讓你為日後的資料交換與網頁開發打下基礎。別再讓資料亂成一團，用資料結構，讓你的程式邏輯清楚又強大！

en.title: Python Data Structures: Keep Your Data Organized!
en.description: Too much data and don't know how to store it? This lesson will introduce you to the four most commonly used data structures in Python: list, tuple, set, and dict, teaching you how to organize and manipulate information correctly. From "how to store" to "how to find" and "when to use which structure," practical exercises will help you get started quickly. In addition, we'll introduce how to convert dictionaries to JSON format, laying the foundation for future data exchange and web development. Don't let your data become a mess anymore; use data structures to make your program logic clear and powerful!

zh.title: Python Function：解決程式設計的日常
zh.description: 這堂課將帶你認識 Python 中的函式與模組，學會如何設計清晰、可重複使用的程式碼。從基礎語法到進階技巧，包含 lambda、裝飾器與模組化實作，打造屬於自己的程式「工具箱」，提升開發效率與維護性。

en.title: Python Functions: Solving Everyday Programming Problems
en.description: This course will introduce you to functions and modules in Python, teaching you how to design clear, reusable code. From basic syntax to advanced techniques, including lambda expressions, decorators, and modularization practices, you'll build your own program "toolbox," improving development efficiency and maintainability.

zh.title: 網路概論：理解數位世界的運作原理
zh.description: 每天你在手機滑著 Threads、Instagram，又或是在電腦上打開瀏覽器逛著各種網頁，你是否有想過這些內容是如何呈現在你的眼前？聽到伺服器這個詞，你想到了什麼？架伺服器真的有這麼困難？到底伺服器要做什麼事情？ 這堂課程將帶你看透一切，過去對你來說或許是黑魔法的未知領域，在課程過後相信你對世界會有嶄新的看法！

en.title: Introduction to the Internet: Understanding How the Digital World Works
en.description: Every day, as you scroll through Threads and Instagram on your phone, or browse various websites on your computer, have you ever wondered how this content is presented to you? What comes to mind when you hear the word "server"? Is setting up a server really that difficult? What exactly does a server do? This course will take you through it all. What may have been unknown territory that seemed like black magic to you in the past will give you a completely new perspective on the world after you finish the course!

zh.title: 廣度課程 - 不止於 CSS
zh.description:
在這個 Vibe Code 的時代下 AI 可以獨立完成越來越多的工作，不用會寫一行程式就能夠做出各種專案。難道我們之後都只能當 prompt engineer？那我還需要知道這些基礎語法嗎？
我會以國際網頁設計競賽評審的角度和你分享現在的網頁設計與開發趨勢在哪，如何做出 prompt 不出來的驚豔網頁。
從前期的觀察到後續的維護，一個專案的孵化不只是寫語法。寫了九年的全端工程，我們來一起討論如何讓一個好的想法被呈現，AI 現階段可以做什麼，不能做什麼，如何與他合作，以及我們需要具備哪些能力。

en.title: Breadth Courses - More Than Just CSS
en.description:
In this era of Vibe Code, AI can independently complete increasingly more tasks, creating various projects without needing to know how to write a single line of code. Does this mean we'll all be relegated to being prompt engineers? Do I still need to know these basic syntaxes?

I will share with you, from the perspective of an international web design competition judge, current trends in web design and development, and how to create stunning websites that prompts can't display.

From initial observation to subsequent maintenance, the incubation of a project involves more than just writing syntax. Having worked on full-stack engineering for nine years, let's discuss how to bring a good idea to life, what AI can and cannot do at this stage, how to collaborate with it, and what capabilities we need to possess.

zh.title: Python Package 與環境管理：讓你的專案乾淨又可攜！
zh.description: 這堂課會帶你從 0 開始認識 Python 的套件系統，學會如何寫出自己的 Package，並用 uv 建立虛擬環境來管理套件與相依性。你將了解為什麼「版本管理」這麼重要、什麼是虛擬環境、怎麼讓你的專案可以輕鬆交給別人執行。從 Hello World 到 cowsay，再到完整的可攜式專案實作，手把手教你寫出乾淨又不會「撞套件」的 Python 專案！

en.title: Python Package and Environment Management: Make your projects clean and portable!
en.description: This course will guide you from scratch into Python's package system, teaching you how to write your own packages and use UVs to create virtual environments to manage packages and dependencies. You'll understand why version control is so important, what virtual environments are, and how to easily delegate your projects to others. From Hello World to cowsay, and then to a complete portable project implementation, you'll learn step-by-step how to write clean Python projects that won't "clash with other packages"!

zh.title: FastAPI 入門：打造高效能 Web API
zh.description: 這堂課帶你從零開始學習 FastAPI，快速打造高效能的 Web API！你將掌握如何處理 HTTP 請求與回應、實作路由、處理 Path 和 Query 參數，並學會如何使用 Pydantic 進行資料驗證。我們將一步一步帶你實作一個包含 CRUD 功能的 Todo List，並了解如何處理 Middleware、OAuth2、JWT 等進階主題。透過實作和範例，讓你輕鬆上手 FastAPI，開發自己的 Web 應用程式！

en.title: Getting Started with FastAPI: Building High-Performance Web APIs
en.description: This course will guide you through learning FastAPI from scratch, enabling you to quickly build high-performance Web APIs! You'll master how to handle HTTP requests and responses, implement routing, manage path and query parameters, and learn how to use Pydantic for data validation. We'll walk you step-by-step through building a Todo List with CRUD functionality and explore advanced topics such as Middleware, OAuth2, and JWT. Through hands-on practice and examples, you'll easily get started with FastAPI and develop your own web applications!

zh.title: HTML + CSS + JS + AI 進階使用與前後端整合：打造現代化網頁應用
zh.description: 這堂課將帶領學員從 HTML 開始，加上 CSS 與 JavaScript 語法加持，結合 AI 技術提升開發效率，實作完整的前後端整合。學員將學會如何使用 AI 產生前端代碼並串接後端，打造功能完善的 Todo List 應用，並探索如何使網頁變得更加炫酷與現代化。這不僅是一堂技術課程，還將激發學員的創造力與設計感，開啟網頁開發的無限可能！

en.title: Advanced use of HTML + CSS + JS + AI and front-end/back-end integration: Building modern web applications
en.description: This course will guide students from HTML, through CSS and JavaScript syntax, and incorporating AI technology to improve development efficiency, providing a complete front-end and back-end integration experience. Students will learn how to use AI to generate front-end code and connect it to the back-end to create a fully functional to-do list application, and explore how to make web pages more visually appealing and modern. This is not just a technical course; it will also inspire students' creativity and design sense, unlocking the infinite possibilities of web development!

zh.title: 版本管理與部署：從 Git 到 Google Cloud 的完整流程
zh.description: 這堂課將引導學員深入理解版本管理與部署的完整流程，從 Git 的基礎與進階操作學起，掌握如何管理專案的版本與協作，再將學到的技能應用於現代部署流程中。學員將學會如何使用 Git 進行版本控制、衝突解決與遠端操作，並使用 Google Cloud 部署 Python 後端與 HTML 前端網頁。課程中也將介紹 CI/CD 的基本概念，並帶領學員實作一個完整的部署流程，讓專案能夠快速上線並穩定運行。

en.title: Version Control and Deployment: The Complete Process from Git to Google Cloud
en.description: This course will guide students to a deep understanding of the complete version control and deployment process, starting with the basics and advanced operations of Git. Students will learn how to manage project versions and collaborate, and then apply these skills to modern deployment workflows. Students will learn how to use Git for version control, conflict resolution, and remote operations, and how to deploy a Python backend and an HTML frontend using Google Cloud. The course will also introduce the basic concepts of CI/CD and guide students through a complete deployment process, enabling projects to go live quickly and run stably.

zh.title: 開源精神短講
zh.description:
「為什麼我們要辦 SITCON？大概是為了吃宵夜時有人能揪一塊去」（Rifur，2013）

對許多新接觸的參與者而言，資訊社群是個不可思議的地方：大家好像都有話直說、勇於表達、互相提攜，也很少有輩分或是上下關係的顧慮。在這場短講裡，我會盡量用簡單的方式帶過資訊社群文化發展的歷史、介紹社群成員彼此協作的方式，以及讓大家了解有哪些地方能找到學習資源、甚至進一步對你喜歡的專案做出有意義的貢獻。

en.title: A Short Introduction to the Open Source Spirit
en.description:
"Why do we hold SITCON? Probably so we can find someone to go out for late-night snacks with." (Rifur, 2013)

For many newcomers, the information community is an incredible place: everyone seems to speak their mind, be open to sharing, support each other, and have few concerns about seniority or hierarchical relationships. In this short talk, I will try to briefly cover the history of information community culture, introduce how community members collaborate, and show you where you can find learning resources and even make meaningful contributions to projects you like.

zh.title: 社群博覽會
zh.description: 我們邀請到許多資訊相關社群前來擺攤，藉由互動遊戲、影片欣賞、專人介紹...等方式，讓學員認識所謂「社群」並對開源活動有初步了解。

en.title: Community Expo
en.description: We invited many information-related communities to set up booths, and through interactive games, video screenings, and expert introductions, we helped participants learn about "communities" and gain a basic understanding of open-source activities.

zh.title: 視界咖啡館
zh.description: 視界咖啡館參考自世界咖啡館（The World Café），在本次夏令營中，我們邀請到各領域及社群知名前輩，將傳統座談會形式改以聊天的樣貌呈現。學員可以與資訊界的名人們近距離互動，期望透過縮短講者與學員之間的距離，講者可以更針對學員給出建議，也鼓勵學員踴躍提問、參與，進而產生良好的雙向交流。

en.title: Vision Cafe
en.description: Inspired by The World Café, Vision Café is a summer camp program that invites renowned figures from various fields and communities to transform the traditional seminar format into a conversational one. Participants will have the opportunity to interact closely with prominent figures in the information industry. By bridging the gap between speakers and participants, speakers can offer more tailored advice, while participants are encouraged to ask questions and actively engage, fostering positive two-way communication.

zh.title: 黑客松發表
zh.description: 在今年的夏令營中，我們深入探索了 Python 程式語法與工具，並進一步了解網頁開發的各項技術。經過五天充實且富有挑戰的資訊科技學習，學員們獲得了豐富的知識與技能，並成功打造了各具創意的專案。現在，讓我們一起向大家展示我們在這段時間裡實踐與創造的功能吧！

en.title: Hackathon
en.description: This year's summer camp delved into Python programming syntax and tools, and gained a deeper understanding of various web development technologies. After five days of intensive and challenging IT learning, participants acquired a wealth of knowledge and skills, and successfully created a variety of innovative projects. Now, let's showcase the functionalities we practiced and created during this time!

zh.name: 吳政賢
zh.bio:
我是一名熱愛寫程式的軟體開發者，對領域沒有偏好，重點是解決問題、實現目的，方法不限。常被問喜歡前端、後端還是系統？老實說，我沒特別偏好。對我來說，能打造出「有人用、有人喜歡」的產品，才是成就感的來源。
我不熱衷追新技術，比起技術本身，我更在意作品能否被真正喜歡。也因為熱愛廟會，我從後端做到前端、系統再到 App，打造出一個超過五萬人好評的實用服務。

#### 分享主題
你是否想過，一款結合宗教信仰與科技的 App 是怎麼誕生的？
讓我帶你深入了解「白沙屯 GPS」這款被五萬人以上使用的 App，如何從一個單純的進香需求出發，逐步實現路線追蹤、即時定位、穩定性優化等功能，背後又如何在傳統文化與現代技術之間找到平衡點。

zh.name: 豆泥
zh.bio:
黃豆泥，由於沈迷網際網路與社會網絡的深層結構，自醫師工作離職，現致力於將密碼龐克精神融入台灣數位社會。現為以太坊諮詢小組「森友會」（Silviculture Society） 成員，並為 2025 年哈佛甘迺迪學院（HKS）民主興革訪問學者。筆者曾任職於數位發展部推動分散式技術。豆泥現同時參與 web3 公民科技社群 FAB DAO，透過區塊鏈技術幫助台灣非營利行動，該組織曾於林茲電子藝術節展出。

#### 分享主題
星星之火可以聯網，我的密碼龐克行動如何介入政府

自從有了密碼之後，網際網路社會有了牆壁、保險箱與個人意識，自由的心靈紛紛遁去虛擬世界，因此網路獨立宣言被寫出來，1990年代的人以為這是烏托邦。

然後世界並沒有如這群人所想，政府監管、平台封建、極權主張與反人類活動也同時進入了網路的世界。究竟我們要自己管自己，還是讓別人管我們，或甚至不得不被別人管？由於實在太好奇這個議題了，我決定加入政府工作，並且第一線參與數位政策的制定過程。如今重回個人公民身分，在此與大家分享。

zh.name: 林子婷 (飛飛／Phoebe 菲比)
zh.bio:
曾任逢甲大學黑客社與台科大資安研究社社長，目前創業擔任七維思執行長，透過「資安這條路，飛飛來領路」品牌推廣。長期投入資安教育、攻防實戰，擅長將艱深技術轉化為友善好懂的資源，建立學習地圖與加強實作能力。希望讓更多對資安有興趣的人，不再徬徨迷惘，而是能找到適合自己的切入點與學習節奏，勇敢踏上資安這條路。

#### 分享主題
資安領域的學習常令人感到困惑，總是不知從何開始，本次分享將結合講者自身從零學起的經驗與多年的教學實踐，帶領學員理解資安學習的全貌，並提供實用的入門建議與策略，包含學習地圖、實作方法與常見誤區。無論你是剛起步的新手，或已具備基礎、想要更進一步，本場分享都將幫助你釐清方向、少走彎路。

zh.name: 趙式隆 (Jack)
zh.bio:
趙式隆先生為現任北市府資訊局局長，作為資料科學家與行動主義者，他致力於推動開放原始碼，打造臺北成為數位世界中的自由、平等與博愛之城。作為連續創業者，他前後創辦了教育科技平台 Zuvio 與保險科技龍頭 BravoAI。作為學者，他是臺大創創的共同創辦人，現仍兼任該學程助理教授，並曾任教於臺大電機系與陽明交大經管所。

#### 分享主題
講者身兼官員、教授、資料科學家與連續創業者，將分享跨界學思歷程，與推動臺北躍升為全球頂尖智慧城市的實戰經驗。內容將聚焦北市府如何以「AI三箭」為核心，用科技驅動城市治理，將「未來之都」的願景化為現實。-
